import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int N;
    static List<String> grid1, grid2;
    static List<List<Integer>> dists;

    static class Edge {
        int src, dst, cap, cost;
        Edge(int s, int d, int c, int co) {
            src = s;
            dst = d;
            cap = c;
            cost = co;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        int nodeCount;
        List<Integer> dist, flow, parent;
        List<Edge> edges;
        int totalFlow, totalCost;

        void init(int n) {
            nodeCount = n;
            dist = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, Integer.MAX_VALUE));
            flow = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, 0));
            parent = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, -1));
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c, int co) {
            edges.add(new Edge(u, v, c, co));
            edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, -co));
        }

        void shortestPath(int source, int sink) {
            init(nodeCount);
            flow.set(source, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            dist.set(source, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            List<Boolean> inq = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(nodeCount, false));
            q.offer(source);
            inq.set(source, true);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inq.set(u, false);
                for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); ++i) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(i);
                    if (e.cap > 0 && dist.get(e.dst) > dist.get(e.src) + e.cost) {
                        dist.set(e.dst, dist.get(e.src) + e.cost);
                        flow.set(e.dst, Math.min(flow.get(e.src), e.cap));
                        parent.set(e.dst, i);
                        if (!inq.get(e.dst)) {
                            q.offer(e.dst);
                            inq.set(e.dst, true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void compute(int source, int sink) {
            if (source == sink) {
                totalFlow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                totalCost = 0;
                return;
            }
            totalFlow = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
            while (true) {
                shortestPath(source, sink);
                if (flow.get(sink) == 0) break;
                for (int cur = sink; cur != source; cur = edges.get(parent.get(cur)).src) {
                    int rev = parent.get(cur) ^ 1;
                    edges.get(parent.get(cur)).cap -= flow.get(sink);
                    edges.get(rev).cap += flow.get(sink);
                    totalCost += edges.get(parent.get(cur)).cost * flow.get(sink);
                }
                totalFlow += flow.get(sink);
            }
        }
    }

    static final int IN_NODE(int x) { return 2 * (x); }
    static final int OUT_NODE(int x) { return 2 * (x) + 1; }

    static MinCostFlow mcf;
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static void bfs(int sx, int sy, List<List<Integer>> dist) {
        dist.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            List<Integer> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                row.add(-1);
            }
            dist.add(row);
        }
        dist.get(sx).set(sy, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(sx * N + sy);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur / N;
            int y = cur % N;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N || dist.get(nx).get(ny) != -1 || grid1.get(nx).charAt(ny) == 'Y') continue;
                if (Character.isDigit(grid2.get(nx).charAt(ny)) && grid2.get(nx).charAt(ny) != '0' && 
                    (dist.get(x).get(y) + 1 <= dists.get(nx).get(ny) || dists.get(nx).get(ny) == -1)) {
                    dist.get(nx).set(ny, dist.get(x).get(y) + 1);
                    if (dist.get(nx).get(ny) != dists.get(nx).get(ny)) {
                        q.offer(nx * N + ny);
                    }
                } else if (dists.get(nx).get(ny) == -1 || dists.get(nx).get(ny) > dist.get(x).get(y) + 1) {
                    dist.get(nx).set(ny, dist.get(x).get(y) + 1);
                    q.offer(nx * N + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void buildAll(List<String> m, List<List<List<Integer>>> all) {
        all.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            all.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(m.get(i).charAt(j)) && m.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    List<List<Integer>> temp = new ArrayList<>();
                    bfs(i, j, temp);
                    all.set(i * N + j, temp);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void connect(int i1, int j1, int i2, int j2) {
        int u = i1 * N + j1;
        int v = i2 * N + j2 + N * N;
        mcf.addEdge(OUT_NODE(u), IN_NODE(v), 1000000, 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        N = n;
        List<String> a = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> b = new ArrayList<>();
        int si = -1, sj = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            a.add(line);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (line.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    si = i;
                    sj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        grid1 = a;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            b.add(br.readLine());
        }
        grid2 = b;
        List<List<Integer>> temp = new ArrayList<>();
        List<List<List<Integer>>> allDists = new ArrayList<>();
        dists = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            List<Integer> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                row.add(1000000000);
            }
            dists.add(row);
        }
        bfs(si, sj, temp);
        dists = temp;
        buildAll(a, allDists);
        mcf = new MinCostFlow();
        mcf.edges = new ArrayList<>();
        mcf.init(4 * N * N + 2);
        int src = 4 * N * N;
        int dst = src + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; ++i) {
            mcf.addEdge(src, IN_NODE(i), 1000000, 0);
            mcf.addEdge(OUT_NODE(N * N + i), dst, 1000000, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a.get(i).charAt(j))) {
                    int idx = i * N + j;
                    mcf.addEdge(IN_NODE(idx), OUT_NODE(idx), 0, a.get(i).charAt(j) - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(b.get(i).charAt(j))) {
                    int idx = i * N + j + N * N;
                    mcf.addEdge(IN_NODE(idx), OUT_NODE(idx), 0, b.get(i).charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(b.get(i).charAt(j)) && b.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    for (int k = 0; k < allDists.size(); ++k) {
                        if (!allDists.get(k).isEmpty()) {
                            int x = k / N;
                            int y = k % N;
                            if (allDists.get(k).get(i).get(j) == -1 || allDists.get(k).get(i).get(j) > t) continue;
                            connect(x, y, i, j);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        mcf.compute(src, dst);
        System.out.println(mcf.totalFlow);
    }
}
